notes.title: DEMO RELEASE! The first two days of the game are now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The demo for "ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD" is now live!

Explore the first two days of this seven day experience as you tackle the daily struggles and challenges of ADHD. Your choices truly matter in this branching narrative of mental health, personal relationships and the ever looming threat of a deadline.



Feedback on the demo of any kind is always appreciated! If you find any bugs, have any suggestions or just want to talk about what you think then we are glad to hear it!



And please be sure to wishlist the full game!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513039/2c514ab756be62d5db6fe53be027fc7aef15c6d7.png"]

This is Lucy, the main character's girlfriend! You can see her in the demo right now!
